description: Na₂O₆BrCl crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁ space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form corner-sharing NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 61-66°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.60 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form corner-sharing NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 61-66°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.63 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one Br atom. The O-Br bond length is 1.69 Å. In the second O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one Br atom. The O-Br bond length is 1.69 Å. In the third O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one Br atom. The O-Br bond length is 1.69 Å. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one Cl atom. The O-Cl bond length is 1.51 Å. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one Cl atom. The O-Cl bond length is 1.51 Å. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one Cl atom. The O-Cl bond length is 1.51 Å. Br is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three O atoms. Cl is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three O atoms.
